name: lt-farm-prices
description: Lithuanian farm products wholesale price dashboard (farm-prices.html) and the VIC bulletin data pipeline.

comments.fetch-prices: Regenerates data/prices.json. Currently a stub that writes seed values flagged verified:false. To produce real data, implement downloadBulletin()/parseBulletin() in scripts/fetch-vic-prices.js — see scripts/README.md.
comments.futureDeps: When implementing the real parser, add ONE of: 'pdf-parse' (PDF text) or 'xlsx' (Excel), depending on the VIC bulletin format.
